snapshot.title: Incident Closed — Hot Wash Initiated

fields.resolution: ENDEX. The emergency is resolved. The firmware patch v2.3.2 has been validated and applied to UAS-11 and UAS-12. The aircraft UAS-02 has been recovered from private property in the Birch Hollow Range by the Calder County Sheriff’s Office. All telemetry logs are intact, and no further incidents have occurred. The Harwick UAS Operations Group has restored full operational status under the new firmware baseline.
finalState: Firmware v2.3.2 is active on GCS-01 and verified in the sandbox.
UAS-02 is secured in a fire-safe container at Hangar 2.
All roles have documented their actions in the HUOG-ERP Section 11.3 log.
The hot wash will begin immediately per HUOG-ERP Section 11.4.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, team. All systems are stable. Put down your radios, close your logs, and prepare for the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things to fix
hotWashQuestions: What critical actions prevented a second incursion during the recovery window?
How did the team’s response to the media inquiries affect public trust?
What changes to the pre-flight checklist would prevent firmware mismatch in future?
How might the DAA-1 log corruption have been detected earlier?
What improvements can be made to the firmware approval process?
